utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Hi, this is Priya from Acme, I head IT there.
Hi Priya, I'm Meera from Northwind. Thanks for taking the time. What made you look at a new CRM?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Our sales and billing data live in different systems, and reconciling them takes my team days every month.
Which systems are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Finance runs on SAP ECC, on-premise, and billing is an old in-house system.
Got it. Do you need the data hosted in a specific region?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Yes, it has to be the EU region, our parent company is in Germany.
Understood. What budget have you set aside for this?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: We have a budget of about forty lakh for the whole project.
That helps. Could you send me an architecture diagram of the current setup?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Sure, I'll send it by Thursday.
Great. Let's do a deeper technical session on Thursday with your team.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Sounds good, I'll bring Arjun from finance. Talk soon.
